title: Abilities tuning
description: Gameplay tuning owned by the Abilities domain: each ability's numbers, keyed by its content ID and grouped by archetype. VeyraAbilities binds it to FVeyraAbilitiesTuning.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's format. A build reads exactly one version.

targetedDamage.description: Abilities cast at one enemy that resolve at once and deal one damage component (Combat Bible §29 targeted, instant). test_bolt is the developer test ability (ADR-006 M3); its values are provisional.

castRange.description: Cast range in units, measured edge to edge (Combat Bible §40).

cooldownSeconds.description: Cooldown in seconds, starting at Commit (Combat Bible §26).

damageAmount.description: Raw damage before any modifier (Combat Bible §25, step 2).
